Motto: Inspired by the Universe, Driven by Innovation. 🚀
summary:
AstroCare AI – AI-Powered Astronaut Health Monitoring and Analysis System

AstroCare AI is an AI-powered web application designed to monitor and analyze astronauts’ health during space missions. The system tracks vital health parameters such as heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), radiation exposure, bone density, and other health indicators.

It uses Python and Flask for backend development, machine learning for health analysis, and HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the frontend. The application provides a dashboard to visualize health data, identify abnormal readings, generate health alerts, and perform AI-based health analysis. It also supports health report generation to help track astronauts’ health conditions over time.

The main objective of AstroCare AI is to support continuous astronaut health monitoring, enable early identification of potential health risks, and assist in maintaining astronaut well-being during long-duration space missions.
details:
What does the project do and how does it work?

AstroCare AI is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring and analysis system designed to support astronaut well-being during space missions. It monitors and analyzes important health parameters, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation (SpO₂), radiation exposure, bone density, muscle health, and other physiological indicators.

The system collects health readings, stores them, and displays them through an interactive dashboard. It identifies unusual readings, generates health alerts, and provides AI-based health analysis to help identify potential health risks at an early stage. It also supports health report generation for tracking changes in astronauts’ health over time.

What are its benefits and intended impact?

Long-duration space missions expose astronauts to several health risks, including radiation exposure, muscle loss, bone density reduction, and cardiovascular changes. AstroCare AI aims to make health monitoring more accessible and organized by bringing important health indicators together in one platform.

Its intended impact is to support early risk identification, improve health-data visualization, assist health monitoring, and contribute to astronaut safety during long-duration space exploration.

What technologies were used?

The project was developed using:

  • Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
  • Backend: Python and Flask
  • Database: SQLite
  • AI/ML: Python-based health analysis
  • Data Visualization: Interactive dashboard and health indicators
  • Report Generation: ReportLab
  • Deployment: Render
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub

What makes the project creative?

AstroCare AI combines multiple astronaut health indicators into a single monitoring platform. Instead of viewing individual health readings separately, users can access health information, alerts, AI-based analysis, and generated reports through one dashboard.

The project focuses on making complex health information easier to understand through visual representations, automated alerts, and organized health records.

What factors did the team consider?

While developing AstroCare AI, we considered the health challenges associated with space environments, the importance of continuous health monitoring, early identification of abnormal readings, ease of use, data organization, and accessibility.

We also considered the need for a scalable system that could be expanded with real-time wearable sensor integration, advanced machine learning models, and additional astronaut health parameters in the future.
